options.name: advanced_conf
options.description: Configure advanced global attributes. It's highly recommended to consult with Check Point's Technical Support before modifying these values.

options.name: allow_remote_registration_of_opsec_products
options.displayName: Allow Remote Registration Of Opsec Products
options.description: After installing an OPSEC application, the remote administration (RA) utility enables an OPSEC product to finish registering itself without having to access the SmartConsole. If set to true, any host including the application host can run the utility. Otherwise,  the RA utility can only be run from the Security Management host.

options.name: authentication
options.description: Define Authentication properties that are common to all users and to the various ways that the Check Point Security Gateway asks for passwords (User, Client and Session Authentication).

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: carrier_security
options.description: Specify system-wide properties. Select GTP intra tunnel inspection options, including anti-spoofing; tracking and logging options, and integrity tests.

options.name: connect_control
options.description: Configure settings that relate to ConnectControl server load balancing.

options.name: data_access_control
options.description: Configure automatic downloads from Check Point and anonymously share product data. Options selected here apply to all Security Gateways, Clusters and VSX devices managed by this management server.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER.

options.name: firewall
options.description: Add implied rules to or remove them from the Firewall Rule Base. Determine the position of the implied rules in the Rule Base, and whether or not to log them.

options.name: hit_count
options.description: Enable the Hit Count feature that tracks the number of connections that each rule matches.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: log_and_alert
options.description: Define system-wide logging and alerting parameters.

options.name: nat
options.description: Configure settings that apply to all NAT connections.

options.name: non_unique_ip_address_ranges
options.description: Specify Non Unique IP Address Ranges.

options.name: num_spoofing_errs_that_trigger_brute_force
options.displayName: Num Spoofing Errs That Trigger Brute Force
options.description: Indicates how many incorrectly signed packets will be tolerated before assuming that there is an attack on the packet tagging and revoking the client's key.

options.name: proxy
options.description: Select whether a proxy server is used when servers, gateways, or clients need to access the internet for certain Check Point features and set the default proxy server that will be used.

options.name: qos
options.description: Define the general parameters of Quality of Service (QoS) and apply them to QoS rules.

options.name: remote_access
options.description: Configure Remote Access properties.

options.name: stateful_inspection
options.description: Adjust Stateful Inspection parameters.

options.name: user_accounts
options.description: Set the expiration for a user account and configure "about to expire" warnings.

options.name: user_authority
options.description: Decide whether to display and access the WebAccess rule base. This policy defines which users (that is, which Windows Domains) have access to the internal sites of the organization.

options.name: user_check
options.description: Set a language for the UserCheck message if the language setting in the user's browser cannot be determined.

options.name: user_directory
options.description: User can enable LDAP User Directory as well as specify global parameters for LDAP. If LDAP User Directory is enabled, this means that users are managed on an external LDAP server and not on the internal Check Point Security Gateway users databases.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: vpn
options.description: Configure settings relevant to VPN.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
